segments.text: Welcome. This AI WorkMate planning call is about local meeting analysis. Transcripts stay under DATA_ROOT.
I finished wiring llama.cpp on Windows. The Qwen 0.5B model runs offline, but it sometimes copies placeholder sentences.
Security cannot send meeting content to a cloud provider. If we cannot keep analysis local, we delay the feature.
Decision one: we keep analysis LOCAL_ONLY with llama.cpp and we do not send transcript content to a cloud provider.
Decision two: DATA_ROOT remains on the user's machine. We will not move meeting files to a remote store.
Decision three: we ship Windows verification of the real AI before we add a larger instruct model.
Omar, please document the llama.cpp install under LocalAppData by Friday 12 September 2026.
Agreed. I will write that install guide and keep it local.
I will review encryption of transcripts under DATA_ROOT before Friday 12 September 2026.
I will add fail-closed tests that reject invented tasks by 10 September 2026.
Open item: I still need budget approval for a 7B local model. That is not decided today.
Risk: the 0.5B model may invent people or copy the prompt example instead of extracting this conversation.
